title: Fabry Disease (Fabry Nephropathy) 臨床表徵、基因病理與酵素替代療法
description: 整合 Fabry Disease (GLA Gene, Alpha-galactosidase A Deficiency) 之遺傳機轉、足細胞 glycosphingolipid 沉積、多器官臨床特徵 (Angiokeratoma, Cornea Verticillata, HCM)、腎臟切片組織病理與電子顯微鏡 (Zebra Bodies, Whorled Myelin Figures)、以及 Enzyme Replacement Therapy (Agalsidase Alfa/Beta) 與 Chaperone Therapy (Migalastat) 之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Genetics, Lysosomal Enzymatic Defects & Sphingolipid Accumulation Cascade
sections.content:
### 1. Genetics & Enzymatic Pathway Topology Matrix

| Parameter | Clinical & Biochemical Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| Inherited Pattern | X-linked Inborn Error of Glycosphingolipid Metabolism |
| Mutated Gene | GLA Gene (Chromosomal locus Xq22.1) |
| Defective Lysosomal Enzyme | Alpha-Galactosidase A (also known as Ceramide Trihexosidase) |
| Accumulating Primary Substrate | Globotriaosylceramide (Gb3 / GL-3 / Ceramide Trihexoside) |
| Bioactive Bioactive Biomarker | Globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) |
| Primary Renal Cellular Tropism | Glomerular Visceral Epithelial Cells (Podocytes), Endothelial Cells, Tubular Epithelium |

### 2. High-Yield Comparison of Lysosomal Storage Diseases with Renal Storage

| Disease | Inheritance | Mutated Gene | Defective Enzyme | Primary Storage Substrate | Renal Histopathology & Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Fabry Disease | X-linked Recessive | GLA | Alpha-Galactosidase A | Globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) | Foamy enlarged Podocytes under LM; Zebra Bodies & Myelin Figures under EM |
| Gaucher Disease | Autosomal Recessive | GBA | Glucocerebrosidase | Glucosylceramide | Gaucher cells (wrinkled tissue paper macrophages) in bone marrow & spleen; rarely renal interstitial infiltration |
| Niemann-Pick Disease (Type A/B) | Autosomal Recessive | SMPD1 | Acid Sphingomyelinase | Sphingomyelin | Sea-blue histiocytes, foamy vacuolated podocytes without zebra bodies |
| Tay-Sachs Disease | Autosomal Recessive | HEXA | Hexosaminidase A | GM2 Ganglioside | Cherry-red spot in macula, no primary renal involvement |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

GLA Gene Mutation ➔ Lysosomal Alpha-Galactosidase A Deficiency ➔ Inability to Cleave Terminal Alpha-Galactosyl Residue ➔ Progressive Lysosomal Globotriaosylceramide (Gb3 / GL-3) & Lyso-Gb3 Accumulation in Glomerular Podocytes, Vascular Endothelium & Smooth Muscle Cells ➔ Podocyte Cytoskeletal Disruption & Foot Process Effacement ➔ Microvascular Luminal Narrowing & Ischemia ➔ Proteinuria, Progressive Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis & Early ESKD.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為 Fabry disease 只會影響男性 Hemizygotes，女性 Heterozygous Carriers 完全無症狀且不需治療。
**Analysis**: 由於女性細胞中隨機 X-chromosome Inactivation (Lyonization) 現象，女性 Heterozygous Carriers 體內帶有突變的 X 染色體與正常 X 染色體的活化比例在不同器官中存在極大個體差異。許多女性 Carriers 也會出現顯著的 Gb3 累積，並發展出 Angiokeratoma, Cornea Verticillata, 甚至嚴重的 Proteinuria, Progressive CKD 與 Cardiac Arrhythmia。診斷女性患者時不能單靠 Plasma Alpha-Galactosidase A Activity (經常呈 Normal 或 Borderline)，必須依賴 Full GLA Gene Sequencing 確立診斷。

sections.title: Module 2: Renal & Extra-Renal Clinical Phenotypes & Systemic Multiorgan Spectrum
sections.content:
### 1. Multiorgan Systemic Manifestations Topology Matrix

| Organ System | Key Clinical Features & Pathognomonic Signs |
| :--- | :--- |
| Renal System | Microalbuminuria, Overt Proteinuria, Microscopic Hematuria, Progressive eGFR Decline, Medullary Cysts, ESKD by 3rd to 5th decade |
| Dermatologic System | Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum (Clusters of non-blanching dark red-to-purple maculopapular lesions in the Bathing-Suit Distribution: lower abdomen, umbilicus, buttocks, scrotum, upper thighs) |
| Ocular System | Cornea verticillata (Whorl-like golden-brown opacity deposits in corneal epithelium visible on slit-lamp), Spokes-like Posterior Capsular Cataracts, Retinal Vessel Tortuosity |
| Neurologic System | Acroparesthesias (Severe burning episodic pain in hands and feet triggered by temperature, exercise, or fever), Anhidrosis / Hypohidrosis, Early-Onset Ischemic Stroke & TIA |
| Cardiovascular System | Concentric Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy, Left Ventricular Hypertrophy, Angina, Arrhythmia, Conduction Block, Sudden Cardiac Death |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison of Hereditary & Glomerular Diseases with Extra-Renal Signs

| Disease | Inheritance | Renal Manifestations | Cutaneous Signs | Ocular / Auditory Findings | Distinctive Extra-Renal Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Fabry Disease | X-linked Recessive | Proteinuria, Hematuria, ESKD | Angiokeratoma (Bathing-suit distribution) | Cornea Verticillata, Retinal Vessel Tortuosity | Acroparesthesias, Anhidrosis, Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy, Early Stroke |
| Alport Syndrome | X-linked (COL4A5) / AR (COL4A3/4) | Microscopic Hematuria, Dysmorphic RBCs, Progressive CKD | None | Anterior Lenticonus, Macular Flecks, Sensorineural Hearing Loss | Thinning & Splitting of GBM (Basket-weave pattern) |
| IgA Vasculitis (HSP) | Immune Complex Meditated | Hematuria, Proteinuria, Crescentic GN | Palpable Purpura (Lower extremities & buttocks) | Episcleritis (rare) | Abdominal Colic Pain, Arthralgia |
| FSGS (Primary/Genetic) | Variable (NPHS1, NPHS2, INF2) | Heavy Nephrotic Syndrome, Progressive Sclerosis | None | None | Steroid Resistance, High Recurrence Post-Transplant |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Lysosomal Gb3 Storage in Vascular Endothelium & Autonomic Ganglion Neurons ➔ Microvascular Luminal Narrowing & Small-Fiber Peripheral Neuropathy ➔ Severe Episodic Acroparesthesias & Anhidrosis ➔ Dermal Capillary Ectasia (Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum in Bathing-Suit Distribution) ➔ Myocardial Storage & Fibrosis (Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy & Cardiac Conduction Block) ➔ Cerebral Small Vessel Occlusion (Early-Onset Stroke & TIA).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 將青年男性的 Acroparesthesias 與 Angiokeratoma 誤診為 Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis 或 IgA Vasculitis (Henoch-Schönlein Purpura)。
**Analysis**: Fabry disease 的肢端灼痛 (Acroparesthesias) 是由於 Small-Fiber Neuropathy 與 Autonomic Ganglion Gb3 累積所致，常在運動、發燒或溫差變化時被誘發，其血清發炎指標 (ESR, CRP) 完全正常；而 Angiokeratoma 為微血管擴張形成的深紅色至紫色微凸斑丘疹，分佈於 Bathing-Suit Distribution (下腹部、臀部、陰囊和大腿上端)，玻片壓迫下不褪色，無壓痛且不隨時間成批出現，與 IgA Vasculitis 的 Palpable Purpura (下肢發炎性紫斑) 在外觀與病理上有明確區隔。

sections.title: Module 3: Histopathology, Electron Microscopy & Differential Diagnostic Matrix
sections.content:
### 1. Microscopic & Ultrastructural Histopathology Topology Matrix

| Modality | Histopathological Findings in Fabry Nephropathy |
| :--- | :--- |
| Light Microscopy (Standard HE / Trichrome) | Enlarged, swollen podocytes with cytoplasmic foamy vacuolization (Honeycomb appearance); Vacuoles are washed out during standard paraffin preparation |
| Toluidine Blue (Plastic-Embedded Frozen Section) | Deeply basophilic dark blue granules accumulating within podocyte cytoplasm, endothelial cells, and tubular cells |
| Polarized Light Microscopy | Birefringent Maltese-cross pattern of lipids in frozen un-extracted tissue section and urinary sediment (Mulberry cells) |
| Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) | Densely packed, concentric whorled lamellated osmiophilic inclusions within podocyte lysosomes (Myelin Figures & Zebra Bodies) |
| Immunofluorescence Microscopy | Negative for immune complexes (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q all Negative); Non-immune storage disorder |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Diagnosis of Renal Lysosomal Inclusions & Zebra Bodies

| Condition | Etiology | Ultrastructural Features (TEM) | Clinical & Diagnostic Distinctions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Fabry Disease | Genetic GLA mutation (Alpha-Gal A deficiency) | Concentric Whorled Myelin Figures & Zebra Bodies in Podocytes, Endothelium & Mesangium | Low Plasma Alpha-Gal A activity; Positive GLA gene mutation; Extra-renal signs |
| Amiodarone Toxicity | Acquired Cationic Amphiphilic Drug Phospholipidosis | Lamellated Myelin Figures & Zebra Bodies in Tubules & Podocytes | History of Amiodarone use for arrhythmia; Reversible upon drug cessation |
| Chloroquine / Hydroxychloroquine Toxicity | Acquired Lysosomal Phospholipase Inhibition | Zebra Bodies and Curvilinear Bodies in Podocytes and Muscle Fibers | History of Malaria prophylaxis or SLE treatment; Hydroxychloroquine myopathy |
| Hurler Syndrome (MPS I) | Alpha-L-Iduronidase Deficiency | Flocculent, clear membrane-bound lysosomal vacuoles; rare zebra bodies | Mucopolysaccharidosis; Coarse facial features, skeletal dysplasia |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Renal Biopsy ➔ Light Microscopy: Enlarged Swollen Podocytes with Honeycomb Foamy Cytoplasm ➔ Electron Microscopy: Concentric Whorled Lamellated Osmiophilic Inclusions (Myelin Figures & Zebra Bodies) inside Podocyte Lysosomes ➔ Confirm Fabry Nephropathy & Exclude Cationic Amphiphilic Drug-Induced Phospholipidosis (Amiodarone / Hydroxychloroquine).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 在電子顯微鏡 (TEM) 切片中看到 Podocyte 內帶有 Zebra Bodies 即直接診斷為 Genetic Fabry Disease。
**Analysis**: 許多 Cationic Amphiphilic Drugs (如 Amiodarone, Chloroquine, Hydroxychloroquine) 能穿過細胞膜並引透 Lysosomal Phospholipase A2 抑制作用，導致次級藥物性 Acquired Phospholipidosis。在 TEM 下，這些藥物引起的脂質過度累積與 Fabry disease 的 Zebra Bodies 和 Whorled Myelin Figures 在形態上幾乎完全相同。因此，切片看到 Zebra Bodies 時，必須詳細核對病患用藥史，並透過 Plasma Alpha-Gal A Enzyme Assay 與 GLA Gene Sequencing 進行最終確診。

sections.title: Module 4: Therapeutic Interventions: ERT, Chaperone Therapy & ESKD Management
sections.content:
### 1. Fabry Therapeutic Modalities Topology Matrix

| Modality | Generic Name | Route & Frequency | Mechanism of Action | Clinical Indications & Prerequisites |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT) | Agalsidase alfa / Agalsidase beta | IV infusion every 2 weeks | Exogenous recombinant enzyme internalized via Mannose-6-Phosphate receptor to clear lysosomal Gb3 | Indicated in all symptomatic males & females with Fabry nephropathy or extra-renal disease |
| Pharmacological Chaperone Therapy | Migalastat | Oral tablet once every other day | Small molecule chaperone binding to and stabilizing specific amenable mutant Alpha-Gal A in ER | Restricted to adult patients with Amenable GLA Gene Mutations and eGFR ≥ 30 mL/min/1.73m2 |
| Adjunctive Nephroprotective Therapy | ACEi / ARB / SGLT2 Inhibitors | Oral daily | Reduces intraglomerular pressure, proteinuria, and slows eGFR decline | Recommended for all Fabry patients with Proteinuria (> 300 mg/day) as baseline adjunctive care |
| Renal Replacement Therapy | Hemodialysis / Peritoneal Dialysis / Renal Transplant | Invasive / Surgical | Clears uremic toxins; Graft parenchyma synthesizes endogenous normal Alpha-Gal A | Indicated upon progression to ESKD; Graft will not suffer primary Fabry storage recurrence |

### 2. High-Yield Comparison of Agalsidase Alfa/Beta vs Migalastat Chaperone Therapy

| Characteristic | Recombinant ERT (Agalsidase Alfa / Beta) | Pharmacological Chaperone (Migalastat) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Administration | Intravenous Infusion (every 14 days) | Oral Capsule (every 48 hours on empty stomach) |
| Mechanism | Direct replacement of missing lysosomal enzyme | Reversibly binds & stabilizes amenable endogenous mutant enzyme |
| Mutation Specificity | Effective regardless of GLA mutation type | Requires specific Amenable GLA Gene Mutation (verified via GLA assay) |
| Immunogenicity | Anti-drug neutralizing antibodies may develop | Non-immunogenic small molecule (No neutralizing antibodies) |
| Renal Function Prerequisite | Usable across all stages of CKD including Dialysis | Contraindicated if eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2 or on Dialysis |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Diagnosed Fabry Nephropathy ➔ Assess GLA Mutation Amenability & eGFR ➔ Early Initiation of IV ERT (Agalsidase Alfa / Beta) or Oral Migalastat (if Amenable Mutation & eGFR ≥ 30) ➔ Clearance of Lysosomal Gb3 Inclusions from Endothelial & Podocyte Lysosomes ➔ Add RAAS Blockade & SGLT2i for Proteinuria Control ➔ Stabilize eGFR Slope & Prevent Progressive Glomerulosclerosis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為已進入 Advanced CKD (如 eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2) 或 Dialysis 的 Fabry 病患應停止或延遲給予 Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT)。
**Analysis**: 這是腎專甄試常見的經典命題陷阱！雖然 ERT 在疾病早期 (尚未出現廣泛 Glomerulosclerosis 前) 對減緩腎功能惡化的效益最高，但對於已進入 Advanced CKD 或 Dialysis 的 Fabry 病患，ERT 仍能有效清除心肌細胞 (Myocytes) 與血管內皮的 Gb3 沉積，顯著減緩 Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy, Cardiac Arrhythmia 與 Cerebral Ischemic Stroke 的發生率與死亡風險。因此，除非病患進入末期失智或預期壽命極短，否則不應僅因 eGFR 下降而終止 ERT 治療。
